entries.title: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition 26.60 Changelog
entries.shortText: Minecraft: Bedrock Edition 26.60 ChangelogBrrrr! Did the temperature just drop? Something drop related is going on, namely the addition of some experimental features from the upcoming game drop! Dive into the ice caves to check out the new icicles, ice cry

entries.title: 26.50 - Wilderness Bound
entries.shortText: Wilderness Bound is out now in Minecraft! Pack your supplies and set off on an expedition into the dappled forest where the trails end and adventure begins. Seek out abandoned camps, build outposts among the poplar trees, sleep under the stars on straw bed
